I asked about having one of the designs listed as a PDF printed and they only responded with an automated message. I'm not sure if this is just a big box store posing as an 'artist' on Etsy or what, but it was impossible to reach a human...only got automated responses saying they are too busy to actually respond to questions. Then when I reached out about where my item was because of the super long shipping, all I got for a response was a screen shot of the tracking label.  This is the first negative review I've ever left for an Etsy seller in all my years on this site. Don't claim to be an artist in California if you are really operating out of a factory overseas...it's deceptive and wrong. Etsy is for artists and individuals!

I ordered a printed student planner. The product description said that it would be printed and shipped within 48 hours. It was not shipped out for 13 days. It was sent through FedEx, so I thought I might still get the planner before school started. Nope.

The tracking info showed the book taking a slow drive across the country from Massachusetts (NOT California) before getting lost in Washington State. At which point the tracker showed FedEx relaying the shipping info to the USPS.

Weeks after my order, the shop owner initially shrugged and told me to contact FedEx and the post office to hunt down the package and go get it myself. The order was Refunded only after I opened a case with Etsy and provided them screenshots of the product and shop descriptions and emails showing the timeline.
